prompt: ぼたんおすとはなびがでるやつ
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ja">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>はなび</title>
<style>
  body { margin: 0; height: 100vh; background: #001a33; overflow: hidden; position: relative; font-family: sans-serif; }
  button {
    position: fixed; bottom: 30px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    font-size: 32px; padding: 16px 40px; border-radius: 999px; border: none;
    background: #ffcc00; color: #333; cursor: pointer;
  }
  .spark {
    position: absolute; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: fly 1s ease-out forwards;
  }
  @keyframes fly {
    to { transform: translate(var(--dx), var(--dy)); opacity: 0; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <button id="b">うちあげ！</button>
  <script>
    document.getElementById('b').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const cx = innerWidth / 2;
      const cy = innerHeight / 2;
      const colors = ['#ff5577', '#ffcc00', '#66ddff', '#88ff88', '#ff88ff'];
      for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
        const s = document.createElement('div');
        s.className = 'spark';
        s.style.left = cx + 'px';
        s.style.top = cy + 'px';
        s.style.background = colors[i % colors.length];
        const angle = (i / 30) * Math.PI * 2;
        s.style.setProperty('--dx', Math.cos(angle) * 200 + 'px');
        s.style.setProperty('--dy', Math.sin(angle) * 200 + 'px');
        document.body.appendChild(s);
        setTimeout(() => s.remove(), 1000);
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
explanation: ボタンを おすと はなびが ひろがるよ！色がいっぱいで きれい。
why: イベント+JS動的DOMの最小例。setTimeout忘れ・setProperty構文ミスを潰す

prompt: にじいろのボールがあちこちにとぶやつ
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ja">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>にじいろボール</title>
<style>
  body { margin: 0; height: 100vh; background: #111; overflow: hidden; }
  .ball {
    position: absolute; width: 60px; height: 60px; border-radius: 50%;
    animation: bounce 3s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes bounce {
    0%   { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    25%  { transform: translate(70vw, 20vh); }
    50%  { transform: translate(20vw, 70vh); }
    75%  { transform: translate(80vw, 60vh); }
    100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <script>
    const colors = ['#ff4444','#ffaa00','#ffee00','#44dd44','#44ddee','#5577ff','#cc44ff'];
    colors.forEach((c, i) => {
      const b = document.createElement('div');
      b.className = 'ball';
      b.style.background = c;
      b.style.left = (i * 12) + 'vw';
      b.style.top  = (i * 8)  + 'vh';
      b.style.animationDuration = (2 + i * 0.3) + 's';
      document.body.appendChild(b);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
explanation: ボールが7いろで あちこちに とぶよ！色によってスピードもちがうんだ。
why: ループ生成+animationの最小例。vw/vh単位の理解確認
